name: Deer
summary: Fine legs, small antlers, a body dappled with light.
text:
Standing, on fine legs, with small antlers and its head raised. The body is dappled — each spot is a point of light.

A delicate piece of thin lines, for anyone who likes their decoration quiet.

options.name: Power
options.help: Batteries are not included. The mains version comes with a remote: on, off, dimmer, timer and a slow pulse.

options.name: Laser engraving
options.help: A name, a date or a short phrase, burned into the wood. Leave it empty if you would rather not.
